pages.title: A note for the counter
pages.body:
Welcome to Neon Undertow. The new customers, factions and shops join your normal playthrough; there is no activation key. Customers arrive through ordinary visits, so you will meet them over time.

Keep this little book cubby in your main shop or put it inside the Dossier to sort your collection. Double-click it to open, then activate a handbook to read. Use the book's index and page arrows. You can take a book out and move it like any other item.

pages.title: Keep the counter clear
pages.body:
The corner guide is off by default. If you prefer a shortcut, open Mods, select Neon Undertow, then Settings and turn on Show corner guide. The change takes effect immediately. Startup status is also available there.

The cubby accepts your owned books and paper documents, including vanilla handbooks. Recipe books still need to be bought or earned. Move a recipe book into its machine's INPUT when you want to craft. Keeping it in this cubby does not unlock production remotely.

Replacement Undertow guides and empty cubbies are sold on the Co-op's KITCHEN + BOOKS shelf.

pages.title: People and factions
pages.body:
Open FACTIONS and use Next to find the new communities after the vanilla groups. Hover reputation milestones to see what they offer and what happens if your standing falls.

Open your shop and serve visitors normally. Neon Undertow adds regulars to the customer pools, including the Velvet Quay community and upper-class visitors. Story customers keep their original roles.

pages.title: After closing
pages.body:
Once the shop closes, use the normal travel/map menu to visit the night shops.

Quayside Canning Co-op stocks produce, cans, kitchen supplies and books. Its shelves are divided into SODA SUPPLIES, PRODUCE, KITCHEN + BOOKS and CELLAR. Finish a purchase or return the unbought item before changing shelves.

Stock renews daily. Your faction standing can affect offers and prices.

pages.title: Equipment and fixtures
pages.body:
Stormglass Depot Outlet carries storage and water equipment. Undertow Engineering supplies production modules, attachments and packaging pattern chips.

Glassmarket Counter & Fixture Stall stocks signs, lamps and bar equipment: a tool rail, measures, a mixing glass, shaker, blender, serving glass and a bartender's notebook. The tools are separate items; the rail is storage for them.

pages.title: Make room to work
pages.body:
Use BACK > on the right wall to reach the back room. The worktop shares your front counter stock. Click the cabinet or a fitted machine to open it; click the door to return to the shop.

Joe Wild's BACK ROOM services add station bays, storage tiers and fitted equipment. Buy the actual machine before fitting it.

Keep this guide and the book cubby in the main area if that is where you prefer to read.

pages.title: Produce and cooking
pages.body:
Buy fruit, vegetables and pantry goods at the Co-op or food suppliers. Examine produce through the magnifying lens. The ordinary view stays neutral; the enlarged detail reveals maturity, wilting and mold.

Buy cooking instruments and recipe books, then open KITCHEN above the back-room table. Put an instrument and one recipe's ingredients on the worktop, with the listed water and power. Choose the tool and manage heat, attention and timing. Each action advances five seconds. Closing the worktop pauses the batch.

Pans need a Galley or native heating plate; chilling needs a fridge. Tools and recipe books are reusable.

pages.title: Canning and workshop supplies
pages.body:
Keep a Fizzworks Recipe Book in the canner INPUT, or Workshop Recipes / Production Handbook in the Galley INPUT. Choose a recipe with the normal item chooser. Only the listed materials, water and power are used; books and tools remain. Food still needs hands-on cooking.

Source-water quality and each can's condition affect soda quality. Inspect reclaimed cans for wear, dents and rust. This does not test the liquid inside.

For empty metal packaging, use the ordinary printer with a pattern chip from Undertow Engineering, a metal ingot, Metal Printing and CNC modules, and a charged cell.

pages.title: Waterworks
pages.body:
The Industrial Water Generator becomes available at Stormglass Depot from day 28 when you have a Grand Waterworks installed. Its list price is 12,500 credits.

Fit a charged cell. Overnight it generates and fills up to four native 2 L high-quality water bottles, using six power each: 24 for a full set. It needs no ingredient or empty-bottle input. Leave room in OUTPUT.

Starting traits do not grant this generator. Items left in older input or attachment slots stay retrievable. The Waterworks handbook explains the manual bottling equipment and its recipes.

pages.title: Cellar and bar
pages.body:
The Co-op's CELLAR shelf sells a Cellar Bench, Brewing Notes, bottles and culture. Its 76 recipes cover suitable fruits, grains, starch crops and infusions. Choose Ferment, Distill or Infuse and load one combination; batches take nights.

The CELLAR tab stores finished bottles. Use the native powered Age-Well rack for suitable wines, cider and perry. Bottled spirits do not mature merely by being stored.

At the bar, pour using ordinary inventory targeting. Measure portions, activate the mixing glass to stir or the shaker to shake, then pour into a bottle. Stir carbonated drinks. The blender extracts produce juices. Read the bartender's notebook for quantities and recipes.

pages.title: Finding missing content
pages.body:
Enable Neon Undertow in Mods and restart the game. Check Startup status in its Settings. If Steam is still downloading an update, close the game and let it finish before reopening.

New factions are on the later FACTIONS pages. Customer options can disable future arrivals; settings marked Restart required need a restart. Night shops are reached after closing.

The corner shortcut is optional. Hiding it does not disable any content or remove your books.

pages.title: Existing saves
pages.body:
Neon Undertow runs independently and includes its own Cellar Bench and brewing recipes. Back up a save before changing its mod set.

The starter cubby is delivered once per playthrough when there is room on the main counter, including existing saves that have not received it. It does not refill after you move or sell its books. Your cubby contents and bookmarks use the normal item save system.

pages.title: If something goes wrong
pages.body:
If back-room cargo cannot load, saving is blocked to protect the original items. Return to the menu and report the problem.

For a bug report, include the game and mod versions, whether the save is new or existing, other enabled mods, and the steps that led to the problem. A screenshot helps. Startup failures are recorded in Player.log.

The guide explains the tools; it does not repair items, test liquids or skip recipe requirements.
